wrap_language_model_with_retries: wrap a language model with automatic retries on exceptions using exponential backoff and jitter
sample_text_with_retry: sample text from a language model with automatic retries on failures using configurable backoff
sample_choice_with_retry: sample a choice from a language model with automatic retries on failures using configurable backoff
configure_retry_backoff: configure retry behavior with exponential backoff, jitter, max delay, and retry count for a language model
retry_on_custom_exceptions: set up a retry wrapper to retry language model calls on specific exception types
